groups.name: 1. Yellow cross
groups.description: Match the yellow edges; ignore the corners. Skip this step if the cross is already yellow.

groups.name: 2. Orient corners
groups.description: With a yellow cross, match the corners to finish the yellow face.

groups.name: 1. Position corners
groups.description: Match the corner swap; ignore the edges. Skip this step if the corners already line up.

groups.name: 2. Position edges
groups.description: With the corners in place, match the edges. Adjust U to finish.
